name: NVD (NIST)
tagline: US government CVE/CPE vulnerability catalog and API for scanners and SBOMs
description: The National Vulnerability Database (NVD) is NIST’s authoritative US government repository of standards-based vulnerability management data. It provides REST APIs for CVEs, CPEs, and related vulnerability metadata used by security scanners, SBOM tools, and vulnerability management systems.

auth.details: Optional API key via apiKey query parameter or header; higher rate limits with key from self-serve signup

use_cases: look up CVE details by CVE ID
search recent CVEs by keyword or CPE
monitor new NVD vulnerability publications for a product
